meta.name: legacy-modernizer
meta.description: Designs incremental migration strategies, identifies service boundaries, produces dependency maps and migration roadmaps, and generates API facade designs for aging codebases. Use when modernizing legacy systems, implementing strangler fig pattern or branch by abstraction, decomposing monoliths, upgrading frameworks or languages, or reducing technical debt without disrupting business operations.

copy.tagline: 制定渐进式迁移策略，分解单体应用，降低技术债务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在维护老旧代码库，需要安全地迁移到新架构
copy.tagline_en: Design incremental migration strategies, decompose monoliths, reduce technical debt
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a legacy codebase and need to safely migrate to a new architecture

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析老旧代码，设计逐步迁移方案，生成依赖图、迁移路线图和 API 外观代码，并确保业务不中断。
howto.when: 当你提到“遗留系统现代化”、“绞杀者模式”、“增量迁移”、“技术债务”等关键词，或要求分解单体、升级框架时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个绞杀者模式来替换订单模块。
say.note: Claude 会生成外观层和迁移计划。

say.text: 分析这个遗留系统的依赖关系并画出依赖图。
say.note: Claude 会输出依赖映射和风险评估。

say.text: 为这个单体应用制定增量迁移路线图。
say.note: Claude 会分阶段规划并包含回滚策略。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps analyze legacy code, design incremental migration strategies, generate dependency maps, migration roadmaps, and API facade code, ensuring zero business disruption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'legacy modernization', 'strangler fig', 'incremental migration', 'technical debt', or ask to decompose a monolith or upgrade frameworks.

say_en.text: Design a strangler fig pattern to replace the order module.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a facade layer and migration plan.

say_en.text: Analyze the dependency graph of this legacy system.
say_en.note: Claude will output dependency mapping and risk assessment.

say_en.text: Create an incremental migration roadmap for this monolith.
say_en.note: Claude will plan phases with rollback strategies.
